name: NIST IR 8596, Cyber AI Profile (draft)
purpose: How the six CSF functions apply when AI is what you secure, what you defend with, or what attacks you.
what: A draft CSF 2.0 Community Profile that crosses the six functions with three focus areas: Secure, Defend and Thwart.

binds.line: A draft Community Profile: voluntary, and still changing.

verifiedBy.line: A profile to adopt and adapt, not something to be certified against.

sits.line: The AI column. It reuses Layer 1’s functions for AI.

terms.line: A work of the United States government. This round shows the card; the full structure follows in a later round.

related.line: It is built on the CSF 2.0 Core.
The AI RMF covers AI risk as a whole; this profile covers the cybersecurity of it.
